designer_intent.overall: Create an aggressive trip hop arrangement with a prominent vocal focus and modern sample chopping production to convey a slow-building, intense energy mood.

sensei_drum.brief: Generate drum patterns using modern sample chopping and beat repeat techniques matched to the aggressive mood and slow build energy curve.

bass_generator.brief: Produce a minimal deep bassline that supports the rhythm and mood without overwhelming vocals.

harmony_generator.brief: Create chordal textures emphasizing atmospheric pads suitable for trip hop, keeping the harmonic complexity low to maintain space for vocals.

melody_generator.brief: Develop subtle melodic elements using sample manipulations and granular effects to complement the vocal lead.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee arrangement progression ensuring energy dynamic aligns with slow build and aggressive mood, focusing on vocal prominence and sample chopping style.

presetor.brief: Assign appropriate effect presets for each track channel to reinforce modern sample chopping and vocal aggression.

songgps.brief: Coordinate arrangement sections with energy ramps and ensure correct event markers are placed to signal changes and intensity shifts.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio routing for mixmaster focused on preserving raw chopped vocal samples and drum textures.
